seo.titulo: Looking Ahead — passado, desejos e futuro em inglês — Aula 20 Intermediate
seo.descricao: Used to, wish e as condicionais (If I knew…, If you had told me…) numa entrevista sobre carreira e futuro. A aula de fechamento do curso Intermediate da Capy English, com diálogo em áudio.

hero.sub: A conversa final do curso: olhar para trás, dizer o que você queria ter feito diferente e falar do futuro sem medo. Tudo o que você viu no Intermediate, numa entrevista só.

dialogo.sub: 🎙️ Num podcast sobre carreira, o Daniel entrevista a Sofia. Há cinco anos ela era tradutora e se sentia invisível; hoje tem a própria escola de idiomas. Ouça antes de ler a tradução.
achar: If you knew you couldn't fail…

expressoesSub: Frases prontas para contar a sua história e falar do futuro. Uma por slide.

vocab.ex: Five years ago, I was a translator.
I used to feel invisible at work.
She never thought she was an entrepreneur.
Soon there was a waiting list.
I wish I were more patient with myself.
Give me an honest answer, not a safe one.
By the end of the first year, she had quit translation.
In the second year, she hired her first teacher.
Some months, she wondered if she had made a mistake.
She always follows up with her favorite question.
vocab.forms: follow up · followed up · has followed up

expressoes.expr: Where do you see yourself in five years?
expressoes.pt: Onde você se vê daqui a cinco anos?
expressoes.usage: a pergunta clássica de entrevista. Responda com going to, will e I hope
expressoes.example: In five years, I see myself running my own business.

expressoes.usage: para voltar ao passado na sua história. Combina com used to
expressoes.example: Back then, I used to work as a translator.

expressoes.usage: para avaliar o que passou. Combina com I wish e would have
expressoes.example: Looking back, I wish I had started earlier.

expressoes.usage: para admitir a dificuldade antes de contar como você seguiu em frente
expressoes.example: It wasn't easy, but I kept going.

expressoes.usage: keep + -ing: continuar fazendo, mesmo com dificuldade
expressoes.example: There were hard months, but I kept going.

expressoes.usage: para abrir uma resposta sincera, sem a resposta pronta
expressoes.example: To be honest, I was afraid of failing.

personagens.SOFIA: a Brazilian woman (late thirties, brown skin, shoulder-length curly dark hair, coral blouse)
personagens.DANIEL: a man (thirties, light skin, short brown hair, round glasses, gray hoodie)

gramatica.cenaAbertura: In a bright podcast studio inside a language school, {SOFIA} and {DANIEL} sit across a table with two microphones, laughing together, with a cheerful classroom visible through a glass wall.

slides.cena: Five years earlier, {SOFIA} sits alone at a gray office desk piled with documents and dictionaries, looking a little sad, while coworkers walk past without noticing her.

frases.en: I **used to feel** invisible at work.
frases.pt: Eu me sentia invisível no trabalho.

frases.en: She **used to work** as a translator.
frases.pt: Ela trabalhava como tradutora.

frases.en: We **used to live** in a small apartment.
frases.pt: A gente morava num apartamento pequeno.

frases.en: I **didn't use to speak** English at work.
frases.pt: Eu não falava inglês no trabalho.

frases.en: **Did** you **use to** play any sports?
frases.pt: Você praticava algum esporte?

frases.en: He **used to be** very shy.
frases.pt: Ele era muito tímido.

slides.padrao: I wish I **were** braver · I wish I **had** studied
slides.cena: {SOFIA} stands at a window at night holding a mug, thinking, with two small thought bubbles above her head: one with a lion and one with a stack of business books.

frases.en: I wish I **were** braver.
frases.pt: Eu queria ser mais corajosa.

frases.en: I wish I **had** more free time.
frases.pt: Eu queria ter mais tempo livre.

frases.en: I wish I **could** speak French too.
frases.pt: Eu queria saber falar francês também.

frases.en: I wish I **had studied** business.
frases.pt: Eu queria ter estudado administração.

frases.en: She wishes she **had started** earlier.
frases.pt: Ela queria ter começado antes.

frases.en: I wish I **hadn't been** so afraid.
frases.pt: Eu queria não ter tido tanto medo.

slides.cena: {SOFIA} draws a big dream on a whiteboard: a second school building with a rocket taking off beside it, while {DANIEL} watches and smiles.

frases.en: If I **knew** I couldn't fail, I **would open** a second school.
frases.pt: Se eu soubesse que não poderia falhar, eu abriria uma segunda escola.

frases.en: If I **had** more time, I **would travel** more.
frases.pt: Se eu tivesse mais tempo, eu viajaria mais.

frases.en: If she **lived** abroad, she **would speak** English every day.
frases.pt: Se ela morasse fora, ela falaria inglês todo dia.

frases.en: What **would** you **do** if you **won** the lottery?
frases.pt: O que você faria se ganhasse na loteria?

frases.en: If I **were** you, I **would accept** the job.
frases.pt: Se eu fosse você, eu aceitaria o emprego.

frases.en: I **wouldn't worry** if I **were** you.
frases.pt: Eu não me preocuparia se fosse você.

slides.padrao: If you **had told** me…, I **would have** laughed
slides.cena: {SOFIA} laughs while looking at an old photo of herself at the gray office desk, holding it next to a framed picture of her colorful language school.

frases.en: If you **had told** me then, I **would have laughed**.
frases.pt: Se você tivesse me dito naquela época, eu teria rido.

frases.en: If I **had studied** business, it **would have been** easier.
frases.pt: Se eu tivesse estudado administração, teria sido mais fácil.

frases.en: If she **hadn't started** that class, she **wouldn't have found** her passion.
frases.pt: Se ela não tivesse começado aquela turma, não teria encontrado a paixão dela.

frases.en: We **would have arrived** on time if we **had left** earlier.
frases.pt: A gente teria chegado a tempo se tivesse saído mais cedo.

frases.en: If I **had known**, I **would have helped** you.
frases.pt: Se eu soubesse, eu teria te ajudado.

frases.en: What **would** you **have done** in my place?
frases.pt: O que você teria feito no meu lugar?

revisao.en: I **used to hate** speaking in public.
I wish I **had learned** English as a child.
revisao.pt: Eu queria ter aprendido inglês quando criança.

revisao.en: If I **spoke** better, I **would apply** for that job.
revisao.pt: Se eu falasse melhor, eu me candidataria àquela vaga.

revisao.en: If she **had quit** earlier, she **would have saved** time.
revisao.pt: Se ela tivesse largado antes, teria economizado tempo.

gramatica.cenaRevisao: {SOFIA} stands proudly at the entrance of her language school, waving at a group of happy students arriving, while {DANIEL} takes a photo of the moment.

quiz.q: "Eu me sentia invisível no trabalho." (era um hábito)
opts: I used to feel invisible at work.
I use to feel invisible at work.
I used to feeling invisible at work.
I was used feel invisible at work.
quiz.a: I used to feel invisible at work.
quiz.rule: Hábito ou estado do passado: used to + verbo puro.

opts: I wish I were braver.
I wish I am braver.
I wish I will be braver.
I wish being braver.
quiz.rule: Desejo sobre o presente: wish + passado (were).

opts: I wish I had studied business.
I wish I studied business yesterday.
I wish I have studied business.
I wish I would study business before.
quiz.a: I wish I had studied business.
quiz.rule: Arrependimento sobre o passado: wish + had + particípio.

quiz.q: "Se eu soubesse, eu abriria uma escola."
opts: If I knew, I would open a school.
If I know, I would open a school.
If I knew, I will open a school.
If I would know, I would open a school.
quiz.a: If I knew, I would open a school.
quiz.rule: Situação imaginada: If + passado, would + verbo.

quiz.q: "Se você tivesse me dito, eu teria rido."

If you told me, I would laughed.

quiz.a: If you had told me, I would have laughed.
quiz.rule: Passado que não aconteceu: If + had + particípio, would have + particípio.

opts: If I were you, I would accept.

quiz.a: If I were you, I would accept.

livre.pedido: Escreva 2 frases: uma coisa que você costumava fazer (used to) e uma que você queria ter feito diferente (I wish I had…).
livre.exemplo: I used to be very shy in English. I wish I had started speaking earlier.

escrita.titulo: Onde você se vê daqui a cinco anos?
escrita.dica: Escreva 4 ou 5 frases: como você era antes (used to), o que gostaria de ter feito diferente (I wish I had), o que faria sem medo de falhar (If I knew…, I would) e o seu plano (going to).
escrita.exemplo:
Five years ago, I used to avoid speaking English.
I wish I had started practising earlier.
If I knew I couldn't fail, I would work abroad.
Next year, I'm going to apply for an international job.

lacunas.texto: Five years ago, Sofia [[used to]] feel invisible. She was a [[translator]], and she never thought she was the entrepreneur type. If someone had told her about her future, she [[would have]] laughed. Then she started teaching one evening class, and soon there was a [[waiting list]]. By the end of the first year, she [[had quit]] translation. Running a school wasn't easy, and she often wished she [[had studied]] business. But she kept going. Today she interviews candidates, and she always asks them: "What [[would]] you do if you [[knew]] you couldn't fail?"
